ai_summary: Accelya Solutions India Limited reported a modest sequential and year-on-year increase in revenue from operations for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Despite this top-line growth, net profit declined both sequentially and year-on-year, primarily due to a significant increase in total expenses, most notably a 74.5% sequential surge in depreciation and amortisation. This substantial rise in expenses, outpacing revenue growth and leading to reduced profitability, presents a material impact and a red flag concerning operational efficiency and potential underlying asset or accounting changes.
